positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Azure Host Networking, SDN Stack. Working to build the world’s most reliable network.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Azure Core, Host Networking, Software-Defined-Network Stack team.
- Worked on various performance and quality projects for Azure's Virtual Filtering Platform driver that processes every packet on the Microsoft Azure cloud.
- Supported the release of Azure Boost.
- Supported the org as a 24 hour on-call Engineer responding to Host Networking related incidents.
- Developed and deployed the convergence of legacy and modern code bases between hardware generations for Azure's Virtual Filtering Platform and identified telemetry and quality testing gaps between the two.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Completed second internship with Microsoft on the Network Device Interaction team.
- Developed a proof-of-concept for a tool data center technicians could use in Azure data centers.
- Used docker to build an image for the tool and ran containers during testing on various systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed process for upgrading current systems to Python 3.
- Implemented snapshot/release continuous integration builds for Python packages.
- Added Python 3 to linux systems using Salt.
- Modified existing packages for use with Python 2 & 3.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with Azure Networking - Pingmesh team in Redmond, WA.
- Developed a page of front-end tool to aid engineers resolving networking incidents in Azure.
- Project used the BingMaps API with ReactJS, TypeScript, C#, and the ASP.NET framework.
- Presented during Azure Networking Demo.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with Search Knowledge team in Boston, MA.
- Completed project focused on information retrieval and natural language processing.
- Learned about continuous delivery pipelines, agile practices, and code reviews.
- Learned about Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and parallelizing operations.
- Used Apache Spark, Apache MXNet, Elasticsearch, Scikit-learn, etc.
- Created several packages in Java & Python with continuous delivery pipelines.
- Submitted a paper with colleagues to an internal machine learning conference at Amazon.
